Normal (Physical)

moves.name: Last Resort
moves.description:
Normal (Physical)
Base Power: 140
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
This move fails unless the user knows this move and at least one other move, and has used all the other moves it knows at least once each since it became active or Transformed.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description:
Normal (Physical)
Base Power: 120
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.

moves.name: Hammer Arm
moves.description:
Fighting (Physical)
Base Power: 100
Accuracy: 90
Priority: 0
Lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage.

moves.name: Sucker Punch
moves.description:
Dark (Physical)
Base Power: 70
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 1
Fails if the target did not select a physical attack, special attack, or Me First for use this turn, or if the target moves before the user.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Drain Punch
moves.description:
Fighting (Physical)
Base Power: 75
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.

moves.name: Low Kick
moves.description:
Fighting (Physical)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
This move's power is 20 if the target weighs less than 10 kg, 40 if less than 25 kg, 60 if less than 50 kg, 80 if less than 100 kg, 100 if less than 200 kg, and 120 if greater than or equal to 200 kg.

items.name: Life Orb
items.description: Holder's attacks do 1.3x damage, and it loses 1/10 its max HP after the attack.

items.name: Chople Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Fighting-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

items.name: Expert Belt
items.description: Holder's attacks that are super effective against the target do 1.2x damage.

items.name: Metronome
items.description: Damage of moves used on consecutive turns is increased. Max 2x after 5 turns.

items.name: White Herb
items.description: Restores all lowered stat stages to 0 when one is less than 0. Single use.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.description: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.

items.name: Iron Ball
items.description: Holder is grounded, Speed halved. If Flying type, takes neutral Ground damage.

abilities.name: Scrappy
abilities.description: This Pokemon can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

abilities.name: Inner Focus
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot be made to flinch. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

abilities.name: Early Bird
abilities.description: This Pokemon's sleep counter drops by 2 instead of 1.
